note: Rewritten from Snyder 1925; original in English; the OCR has several broken words ("fight"=light, "pul villus"=pulvillus, "5.7-G.2"=5.7—6.2), corrected by context and reflected in the measurements. The original name is Kalotermes (Calcaritermes) imminens, new species.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: (From a dealate female.) Head dark chestnut brown with a reddish tinge, paler below the compound eyes, shining, longer than wide, sloping forwards at the frontal suture, with scattered rather long hairs. Compound eyes black, distinctly not round, projecting, their distance from the lateral margin of the head less than the long diameter of the eye. Ocelli transparent, white, nearly oval, projecting, their distance from the compound eyes less than the diameter of an ocellus, set obliquely to the compound eyes. Antennae pale yellowish brown (the specimen is incomplete, only 8 segments preserved), the segments moniliform, markedly longer and wider after segment 4, with long hairs; segment 3 nearly club-shaped, nearly as long as segment 2 but longer than segment 4. Pronotum coloured as the head, anterior margin broadly and roundly concave, posterior margin nearly straight, anterior corners high, sides sloping smoothly towards the posterior margin, with scattered rather long hairs. Legs yellow with a brown tinge, slender and long; with a pulvillus; femora swollen, the tip of the tibia with 3 slender chitinous spines, one spine of the foreleg longer than the others; with long hairs. Abdominal tergites coloured as the pronotum, each tergite with long hairs at the base, cerci present. Measurements: total length of the dealate female 6.3 mm; head length (to the tip of the labrum) 1.5 mm; pronotum length 0.7 mm; long diameter of the compound eye 0.3 mm; hind tibia length 1.3 mm; head width (at the compound eyes) 1.35 mm; pronotum width 1.1 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head chestnut brown, darker anteriorly (nearly pitchy), rather narrow and elongate, semicylindrical, thick (high), concave in the middle in side view, the dorsal side of the head longer than the ventral side and bearing an overhanging projecting upper margin that is split or flap-like in the middle, yet with the two flaps touching (no opening except at the anterior margin), the anterior margin of the upper margin rough. Head with scattered long hairs. The anterior part of the head is not vertical but slopes ventrally and towards the posterior margin; in front view deeply concave, cupped between the upper margin and the postclypeus. Eye spots dark, indistinct, lying in the depression at the antennal socket. Mandibles pitchy, short and broad, with marginal teeth. Antennae white with a yellow tinge, short, 11 or 12-segmented; the segments widening and lengthening towards the apex, with long hairs; with 11 segments segment 3 is narrow and short, nearly club-shaped, shorter and narrower than segment 2 or segment 4; segment 4 shorter than segment 2; the remaining segments wedge-shaped; the apical segment rather narrow, nearly oval; with 12 segments segment 3 is ring-like and very small, and segment 4 much shorter than segment 2 or segment 5. Pronotum coloured as the head, slightly narrower than the head, anterior margin broadly and angularly concave and nearly straight, posterior margin more roundly and broadly concave, sides sloping gradually towards the posterior margin, with scattered long hairs. Legs white with a yellow tinge, femora swollen, the tip of the fore tibia with 2 spines, plus a chitinised, slender, basally thick, upturned and sharp dorsal spine, with long and short hairs. Abdomen greyish white with a yellow tinge, with long hairs; cerci present, rather slender and long. Measurements: body length 5.7—6.2 mm; head length with mandibles 2.1—2.25 mm; length from the head to the anterior margin without mandibles (dorsal) 1.7—1.85 mm; length from the head to the anterior margin without mandibles (ventral) 1.55—1.6 mm; left mandible length 1.0 mm; pronotum length 0.8—0.85 mm; hind tibia length 0.7—0.8 mm; height of the anterior part of the head 1.4—1.45 mm; height of the posterior part of the head 1.25—1.3 mm; head width 1.4—1.5 mm; pronotum width 1.4—1.45 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Type locality: Cincinnati plantation, Magdalena Department, Colombia; a series of soldiers with nymphs and 1 dealate female was collected by W. M. Mann in February 1924 (month 2). The holotype is a soldier (U.S. National Museum Cat. No. 27734), the morphotype a dealate female. Snyder erected the subgenus Calcaritermes for the species, with it as type species, on account of the overhanging upper margin of the head and the dorsal spine of the fore tibia; the specific name refers to the overhanging upper margin of the head.
